Recorded Muse Session Protocol sessions, copied unchanged from
`schema/msp/transcripts/<name>/transcript.ndjson` in
[meta-models/muse-code-sdk](https://github.com/meta-models/muse-code-sdk)
(MIT License). Each line is `{"dir": "client"|"server", "raw": "<frame>"}`.
The tests replay them as a stand-in Muse host.
